# pcapplusplus / FuzzWriter

pcapplusplus's own fuzz target `FuzzWriter` ([source](source/FuzzWriter.cpp), modified; see below), one of the targets OSS-Fuzz builds, over PcapPlusPlus (seladb/PcapPlusPlus at 7f991319).

Reads every packet of the input capture and writes it to a pcap/pcapng writer (converter shape: .pcap in -> .pcapng out for FuzzWriter, .pcapng in -> .pcap out for FuzzWriterNg), prints writer stats. The written file is never read back or compared with the input, so the conversion is NOT a round-trip check.

## How this program differs from what OSS-Fuzz runs
- Linked against PcapPlusPlus at commit 7f991319 with 2 patches to the library (listed on the project page).
- In every build, getenv() returns NULL, getpid() returns 1 and mkstemp() uses a fixed name, so the program depends only on its input.
- A small driver reads the input file, calls the harness one to four times and prints each return value.
- The harness source differs from the upstream file at the pinned commit; the copy in source/ is the file as built.

## What the harness checks
The harness makes no check of its own beyond not crashing, so a statement about it says only that the code it calls never crashes, hangs or trips a sanitizer.

## Builds
Static riscv64 Linux programs, compiled for RV64G and run as `<file> <input-file>`; `oft fetch pcapplusplus` downloads the published ones and checks each against its SHA-256.

| build | file | bytes | sha256 |
|---|---|---:|---|
| plain | `FuzzWriter.plain` | 1,059,072 | `301dc4a7e95427037df3d158f3b8b0afc3df9c2bd3cd22fa18b98f66ddc8f892` |
| ubsan | `FuzzWriter.ubsan` | 1,060,656 | `9257876debccb60848f510a1465f299a68401dda3780dbc346cc7a467d0f190f` |
| asan | `FuzzWriter.asan` | 1,864,824 | `0dcd71dd724635e1bcf015ef0797b3b85d811f9ad28860403fd171ea5de09367` |
| asan-ubsan | `FuzzWriter.asan-ubsan` | 1,843,704 | `23f8b261f0b8a5f4378b0853ef554b66a50ce2109a5d7a312702efa7de2e46ba` |

Each build also links code that no sanitizer instruments, as its link recorded it. A statement about a sanitizer build covers that code only as uninstrumented code: ASan checks no load or store made inside it, and UBSan inserts no check there.

- plain: `clang_rt.crtbegin.o` (compiler-rt), `libclang_rt.builtins.a` (compiler-rt), `crt1.o` (the C library), `libc++.a` (the C++ runtime), `libc.a` (the C library), `libpcap.a` (a library from the build image), `libunwind.a` (the C++ runtime)
- ubsan: `clang_rt.crtbegin.o` (compiler-rt), `libclang_rt.builtins.a` (compiler-rt), `crt1.o` (the C library), `libc++.a` (the C++ runtime), `libc.a` (the C library), `libpcap.a` (a library from the build image), `libunwind.a` (the C++ runtime)
- asan: `clang_rt.crtbegin.o` (compiler-rt), `libclang_rt.asan.a` (the sanitizer runtime), `libclang_rt.builtins.a` (compiler-rt), `crt1.o` (the C library), `libc++.a` (the C++ runtime), `libc.a` (the C library), `libpcap.a` (a library from the build image), `libunwind.a` (the C++ runtime)
- asan-ubsan: `clang_rt.crtbegin.o` (compiler-rt), `libclang_rt.asan.a` (the sanitizer runtime), `libclang_rt.builtins.a` (compiler-rt), `crt1.o` (the C library), `libc++.a` (the C++ runtime), `libc.a` (the C library), `libpcap.a` (a library from the build image), `libunwind.a` (the C++ runtime)
